steps: Fry the onion in half the oil on medium for 2 to 3 minutes until soft, then add the ginger, garlic and green chilli for a minute.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for about 5 minutes, until very soft.
Take it off the heat, let it cool a little and blend to a smooth paste.
Heat the rest of the oil on medium, add the cumin and, when it sizzles, pour in the paste. It will splutter.
Stir in the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt, and cook 6 to 7 minutes until oil shows at the sides.
Add the peas and about 75 ml water a person and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, until the peas are soft.
Add the paneer, cream and crushed kasuri methi and simmer for just 2 minutes, so the paneer stays soft.
Sprinkle the garam masala and coriander leaves and serve.
note: One recipe used about 15 g onion and 30 g tomato a person and the other about 55 g and 95 g; this follows the second, which gives a proper gravy to eat with roti.
